chunks: The Prophet (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) used to like drinking from the Syrian vessel, and he used to say: 'It is the cleanest of your vessels.'

key_terms.أَنْظَفُ: the cleanest / the purest — superlative form indicating highest degree of cleanliness or purity
key_terms.الْإِنَاءِ الشَّامِيِّ: Syrian vessel — referring to vessels crafted in the region of al-Sham (Greater Syria, encompassing modern Syria, Lebanon, and Palestine), renowned for their quality and cleanliness
key_terms.يُعْجِبُهُ: pleased him / he liked — an expression of habitual preference, indicating a sustained practice rather than a single occasion

ai.seo_question: What type of vessel did the Prophet Muhammad prefer for drinking according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates that the Prophet Muhammad (saww) had a preference for Syrian-made drinking vessels, commending them as the finest and cleanest among all vessels. This hadith reflects the Prophet's attention to cleanliness and quality in daily life, as well as the high regard in which Syrian craftsmanship was held in the early Islamic period. The region of al-Sham (Greater Syria) was known for its skilled artisans and quality glassware and pottery, which the Prophet endorsed for their superior hygiene.
